draft.letter_text: Dear GymCo, I am writing to dispute the $24.99 charge made to my account on [date]. I had previously cancelled my membership with your gym. Please investigate and reverse this charge. I would appreciate a response regarding the outcome of this dispute. Sincerely, [Your Name]
steps: Check your membership status with GymCo
Escalate to bank's dispute team if necessary
Escalate to external dispute resolution if bank's response is unsatisfactory
Ask the merchant — or your bank — to remove the direct-debit authority. Cancelling the subscription alone does not stop direct-debit payments.
